stem_en: According to kinetic theory, the pressure of an ideal gas equals:

option_b_en: (1/3) of the kinetic energy per unit volume
option_c_en: (3/2) of the kinetic energy per unit volume
option_d_en: Total kinetic energy of all molecules
explanation_en: From PV = (1/3)Nm⟨c²⟩ and E = (1/2)Nm⟨c²⟩ ⇒ P = (2/3)(E/V).

stem_en: Kinetic theory supports Boyle's law because at fixed T:
